ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio (~8:1) between the dominant high-intensity white central region and the low-intensity dark grey/black perimeter and trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white (high-intensity) central mass covering roughly 85% of the visible surface area. Dark pigmentation (low-intensity) is mapped strictly to the trailing edge and distal tips, with a small dark protrusion near the median notch on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; frequency increases toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature on both lobes, exhibiting an asymmetrical sweep where the left lobe appears to have a more pronounced vertical lift than the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, vertical/diagonal dark linear marks (rake-like scratches) localized on the left lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle encrustations on the distal tips of both lobes and localized irregular notches on the trailing edge suggestive of past tissue trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: One distinct, isolated dark pigmentation spot located on the right lobe near the median notch boundary.
